title.narrative: PERFORMANCE-BASED PARTNERSHIP SCHEME FOCUSING ON QUALITY PROGRAMMING, UNDERSTANDING CHANGE AND RESULTS FOR POOR HOUSEHOLDS AND COMMUNITIES

description.narrative: During the project duration from May to July 2025, Concern Worldwide successfully implemented an Integrated Emergency Health, Nutrition, and Facility-Based WASH intervention in Banadir Region. The project improved access to preventive and curative healthcare, nutrition support, and essential Water, Sanitation and Hygiene (WASH) services at the health facilities level. . Marker 2.2 was selected because the primary object of the response was the provision of essential nutrition services for comprehensive management and treatment of acute malnutrition among children aged 6–59 months in the catchment area of the supported nutrition facilities. Regular health education messages and the distribution of water treatment tablets to caregivers promoted safe drinking water and reinforce hygiene practices, supporting overall nutrition recovery and disease prevention. Marker 3.8 was selected because the project provided health facilities immunisation services for children under one year for their first visit; and improved emergency referral pathways for cases of life-threatening conditions to secondary health care facilities.
